name: howto
title: The Furhaven dog bed in five minutes
sub: From Furhaven's FAQ and care page, in order
footer: Sources: furhaven.com FAQ and care blog (Jan 26, 2024), read Oct 19, 2026; VCA Hospitals (Jun 2026). The skipped step is the three-day wait.

items.head: Measure your dog
items.body: Lying in the usual sleep pose. Large is 36 x 27 in.

items.head: Unbox and wait
items.body: It ships compressed. Give it a few days to expand.

items.head: Place it well
items.body: Warm, draft-free spot, non-slip floor under it (VCA).

items.head: Wash the cover
items.body: Unzip, cold wash, gentle cycle, then air dry.

items.head: Spot-clean the foam
items.body: Damp cloth and mild soap. Never machine wash it.

items.head: Check at six months
items.body: If your dog bottoms out, size up or replace.
